91.snippet: function s.decop(e,tp) Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,tp,HINTMSG_OPERATECARD) local tc=Duel.SelectMatchingCard(tp,s.decfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,1,nil):GetFirst() if not tc then return end local b1=tc:IsAbleToHand() local b2=tc:IsAbleToGrave() local op=b1 and b2 and Duel.SelectOption(tp,aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,2),aux.Stringid(STRING_ID,3)) or (b1 and 0 or 1) if op==0 and Duel.SendtoHand(tc,nil,REASON_EFFECT)>0 then Duel.ConfirmCards(1-tp,tc) else Duel.SendtoGrave(tc,REASON_EFFECT) end end
